get.description: Ad accounts of this organization with their sync status and health.
Every campaign (removed ones included) with its figures for the period.

post.description: "Sync now": the structure and the last 30 days (limited per account).

put.description: Which store the account's spend belongs to; null = the whole organization (Phase 6).

get.description: Analytics properties of this organization with their sync status and health.

Daily figures in the property's time zone, reported by the platform (30 days by
default): the total view day by day, or a breakdown by channel or by source / medium /
campaign. Users are given per day only.

put.description: Which store the property measures; null = the whole organization (Phase 6).

Every campaign's platform-reported figures, budget use against today's budget, and
Google Analytics' figures for the campaign of the same name.

Impression → purchase for the period: each stage with its source, the steps (a rate only
between stages of the same source), each platform's and channel's own funnel, and the
drop-offs found by fixed rules (funnel-v1).

Each campaign's funnel as its platform reports it, Google Analytics' funnel for the
campaign of the same name, and the other traffic.
Google Analytics' funnel for each landing page, most visits first (at most 100).

Sales, ad spend and profit together, in the reporting currency (analytics-v1), by day
and for the period, with sources, freshness and the exchange rates used.
Every product sold: units, net sales, product cost, gross profit and margin.
One campaign with its budget, ad groups and ads, each with its period figures.
Stores of this organization with their sync status and history limit.
Daily figures (store time zone, finance-v1) with availability; defaults to 30 days.

post.description: "Sync now": a full check of the catalogue and recent orders (rate-limited per store).
